review.criteria: Four independent ten-image sets; horizontal crops, recognizable desert subjects, no watermarks, and no reused files across carousels.

hollywoodReview.scope: Arrival-day gallery; upgraded again following user request for professional Hollywood, Burbank and studio photography
hollywoodReview.notes: Compared city and studio contact sheets; selected sunset/blue-hour compositions, two Warner Bros. backlot photos, Bob’s Big Boy and Burbank panorama. Replaced eight weaker or repetitive earlier frames. Retained two strongest Griffith/city-light images. Rejected warehouses, near-duplicate backlot frames, underlit street scenes and low-resolution tower image. Studio captions explicitly indicate optional, unbooked access.
